blind_to: Written without opening modulo-triage-cases.json or morphyx-triage-cases.json. Their .md files name a few of their ids and labels (M22 none, B01/B02 bail, X17/X18/X20/X40 owed); I saw those, nothing else.

labels.day: worth a session of ours: new data, a new mechanism, or a correction that needs re-checking against the ledger
labels.quick: worth a few lines, drafted for a second part's yes. While the door refuses replies, 'quick' means 'read first, draft', per MX-DOOR
labels.none: read, nothing owed. Never 'unread': the decider orders the pile, it doesn't empty it

focus: Clearing-shaped cases: mentions the thread already serves, repeats, stale questions, filler, plus the slow ideas I'm most likely to label none wrongly. Tag slow-idea marks my blind spot: where my instinct said none, I've written down why I overrode it.
